name: Chacarera doble
label: CHACA DOBLE
source: the chacarera's bombo; doble differs only in form (12-bar sections, not 8): Paredes (UNCuyo) 2025 p. 27; Mola (FBA-UNLP) corpus of 127 simples and 23 dobles; tempo a practice default

sources.title: Paredes, tesina de Licenciatura en Musica Popular (UNCuyo 2025)
sources.shows: Simple and doble are the same chacarera, told apart by section length: 8 bars (simple) or 12 bars (doble); fig. 20 gives one basic chacarera bombo pattern, not split by type

sources.title: Mola, Analisis del aspecto ritmico en la melodia y en el acompanamiento de la chacarera (FBA-UNLP)
sources.shows: Corpus of 127 simple and 23 doble chacareras analysed together; dobles have 12-bar segments; one basic bombo scheme (eje estructural) is given for the whole corpus
